Voted “Best Food Truck in Denver” by 5280 Magazine, our hearty bowls will fill you up
without bogging you down. Crock Spot Gourmet Food Trucks and Catering offers the
Denver Metro area slow-cooked goodness. All of our proteins, including our vegetarian &
vegan options, are cooked slowly to mouthwatering perfection, served over healthy grain
varietals and topped with an international sauce of choice.
Our “quick serve” concept makes sure our guests never wait in a long line. Our team can
have a guest served in 25 seconds or less, which makes our cuisine ideal for any time
sensitive event. Our unique concept invites our customers to “choose their own adventure”
when ordering.

Logo Implementation
CLEAR SPACE
Logo must have ample space surrounding it.
All other content near the logo should at least
be a minimum distance of the height of the
lowercase “o” in “Spot” away.
COLORS
Do not alter logo colors.
OTHER ALTERATIONS
Do not add a stroke or heavy drop shadow around the logo.
PROPORTIONS
Never alter the original proportions of the logo
by stretching, squishing, or skewing it.
SIZING
Minimum size 0.3125 in high.
Avoid losing legibility.

Photography
PHOTOGRAPHIC STYLE
Photography should be fun, bright, and full of color. Subject matter should be food and service
focused and include images of happy customers. Ideally, the hues within the photos should include
touches of the purple, green, red, and gold from the brand palette.
10
Copy standards
EDITORIAL STYLE
• Don’t use quotation marks when quoting song lyrics.
• Pun hard and pun often.
• Use exclamation points to enhance copy. Use sparingly and never
more than one at a time.
• Use all capital letters to emphasize some words as needed. Never
use two all capital words in the same sentence.

11
messaging
VOICE
• Authentic and approachable
• Warm and inviting
• Fun and friendly
• Simple and conversational
TONE
Crock Spot’s tone is friendly and conversational. Maintain a casual
tone while fitting in “crock” puns wherever possible.
When writing short taglines and sayings, use popular lyrics with
“crock” in place of a word in a rock song.
Ex: We will, we will, CROCK you.
Ex: Let’s give them something to CROCK about.
When describing the food, maintain an informative and fun tone
while describing flavors.
Ex: A fan favorite! Sriracha is an Asian hot sauce made from chili
paste. We mix it with sour cream for a MEDIUM heat sauce.
12
Customer personas
CUSTOMER 1
Kelly is a 39-year-old woman with two kids aged 13 and 9. She
values eateries that allow her and her children to customize their
own meals while still being quick and healthy. Her 13-year-old has a
gluten allergy and she prefers to eat vegan meals whenever possible.
CUSTOMER 2
Josh is a 25-year-old business development representative at
a software start up. He goes out to lunch with coworkers every
weekday and prefers places that have healthier options and a lot
of variety. He’s a busy guy, so he prefers fast casual but is tired of
burritos and pizza all the time.
CUSTOMER 3
Pierce is a 30-year-old barista who loves to travel and try new
things. He prefers healthy options and enjoys trying new foods from
different cultures. He enjoys a fancy dinner but is budget conscious
so he tends to eat at affordable, fast-casual restaurants.
